alerts.title: Live: Houthis advance in Yemen as tankers hit sea mines in Strait of Hormuz
alerts.why: Tanker strikes in the Strait of Hormuz threaten vital crude supply chokepoints, triggering severe geopolitical risk premiums.

alerts.title: Tankers hit in Strait of Hormuz as drone raises alarm at Iraq gas field
alerts.why: Tanker attacks and rising military tensions in the Strait of Hormuz threaten critical Middle Eastern crude supply routes, sparking severe supply disruption fears.

alerts.title: Iran escalates threats as third U.S. carrier arrives in Middle East, tanker struck in Hormuz
alerts.why: Tanker struck in Strait of Hormuz and escalating US-Iran military tensions threaten critical crude supply chokepoint.

alerts.title: Russian October crude exports fall 36.6% on month despite US sanctions waiver
alerts.why: Russian October crude exports plunged 36.6% month-over-month to 2.79M bpd, tightening global supplies significantly despite waivers and Chinese demand.

alerts.title: Vessels on fire after naval mine hit in Hormuz Strait, Iran says
alerts.why: Strait of Hormuz closure and mine strike threaten massive global crude supply disruptions, sparking extreme geopolitical risk premium.

itemsSent.title: Maersk, Hapag-Lloyd Expand Suez Canal Return With Three More Gemini Services
itemsSent.why: Return to Suez Canal shortens voyage times, lowering bunker fuel demand and easing supply chain friction, putting mild downward pressure on crude.

itemsSent.title: Saudi Arabia dismisses commander of coalition forces fighting Houthis
itemsSent.why: Red Sea military reshuffle and tactical withdrawal suggest lingering security risks, though immediate supply disruptions remain limited.

itemsSent.title: Oil prices fall as Mideast supply recovery outweighs Iran risks
itemsSent.why: Recovering Middle East exports and expected global supply surplus outweighing Iran risks, pushing Brent down.

itemsSent.title: India Wholesale Inflation Highest in 4 Years
itemsSent.why: Indian wholesale fuel and crude inflation hit a four-year high, signaling strong domestic energy demand despite rising costs.

itemsSent.title: Japan Q3 GDP Unexpectedly Stalls
itemsSent.why: Japan Q3 GDP stalled and private consumption fell, signaling weaker economic momentum and lower energy demand from the world's fourth-largest oil importer.

itemsSent.title: ONE Joins Maersk, Hapag, and Others in Return to Suez Canal
itemsSent.why: Return to Suez Canal shortens voyage times, lowering global shipping fuel demand and easing supply chain logistics concerns.

itemsSent.title: EU Targets Shadow Fleet Shipowners, Managers and Insurers in New Russia Sanctions
itemsSent.why: New EU sanctions on Russia's shadow fleet complicate maritime logistics and slightly tighten effective crude supply, supporting Brent prices moderately.

itemsSent.title: Oil Prices Slide as Global Glut Fears Eclipse Hormuz Attacks
itemsSent.why: Global glut fears and oversupply sentiment are currently dominating market psychology, overshadowing ongoing geopolitical risks in the Persian Gulf.

itemsSent.title: EU widens shadow fleet crackdown to tanker managers and oil buyers
itemsSent.why: EU broadening sanctions on Russia's shadow fleet to include managers and buyers raises compliance friction, incrementally tightening global seaborne crude supply.

itemsSent.title: Iran and Oman Hold Talks on Strait of Hormuz Security as Tanker Attacks Surge
itemsSent.why: Talks between Iran and Oman to secure the Strait of Hormuz lower immediate risk premium on crude supplies, easing fears of tanker disruptions.
